title: Compute Voronoi cells from the vertices of geometries — voronoi_cells
text: Every vertex geometry treated site, multipoint k points yields k cells. Voronoi diagram unbounded, cells clipped: "padded" uses box 50 percent padding around sites, matching PostGIS ST_VoronoiPolygons, "envelope" uses exact bounding box. Passing boundary clips arbitrary polygon instead, usual way cut diagram study area. geometry fewer two distinct vertices, one whose vertices collinear, cells comes back empty multipolygon rather null. Use voronoi_edges() collinear case, returns perpendicular bisectors. null geometry stays null.
